basis: Frozen v1 specification section 8 explicitly permits reassessment before large cost collection if ordinary modular decomposition suffices
prerequisites: All fourteen main trajectories and separate/ledger/order controls completed
Single fixed executable and modular core across T0-T3 diagnostic runs
Identical numeric profiles/inputs between U and M
Generic module factory executes T1/T2/T3 via declarations without per-task core changes
action: No-Go for H3 structural extension-burden advantage in these tasks; do not collect 256 cost references or forty cost runs
preserve: Keep original plans and classify these conditions as not run due to structural stopping; do not report performance superiority
rationale: Timing alone or dispatch/barrier differences cannot establish the system-model contribution sought here. A general modular construction is already the stated null hypothesis.
limitations: Written after T0 comparison outcomes, before any performance outcome. This is an operational stopping rule of the existing design, not a claim of blind preregistration.
